quest_alva_road_bag.title: One Lonely Bag
quest_alva_road_bag.summary: You found an empty bag near the road to Lastdenn. Who could it belong to? It was dropped in the morning, but when exactly?

1.taskPhrase: Find out when and by whom the bag was dropped.
1.updatedPhrase: Talk to the traveler standing near the road just a little past 09:00 and receive a present from her.
